title: Reduce bihun soaking time
expertAction: Reduce bihun soaking time from 10 min to 5-6 min in room temp water. If stir-frying, add bihun in the last 2-3 minutes only, over high heat (wok hei).
rootCause: Overcooking or soaking too long before frying

customerQuote: Ayam percik terlalu kering, macam jerky
title: Fix dry chicken — reduce grill time
expertAction: 1) Reduce grilling/frying time by 2-3 minutes. 2) Add 1 tbsp oil or yogurt to marinade. 3) Rest chicken 5 min before serving to retain juices. 4) Use meat thermometer — pull at 74°C internal, not higher.
rootCause: Overcooking or lack of marinade fat/moisture

customerQuote: Waited 30 minutes for my food during lunch, almost walked out
title: Speed up peak-hour kitchen flow
expertAction: 1) Analyze peak-hour order tickets to identify bottleneck station. 2) Add 1 extra prep cook during identified peak windows. 3) Pre-prep mise en place before service to cut cook time by up to 30%. 4) Set target ticket times: appetizers 8 min, mains 15 min.
rootCause: Kitchen bottleneck during peak hours, understaffing, or poor order sequencing
